'''Pea soup''' or '''split pea soup''' is [[soup]] made typically from dried [[pea]]s, such as the [[split pea]]. It appears in the [[cuisine]] of many cultures, with a wide range of variations. It is most often greyish-green or yellow in color depending on the regional variety of peas used; all are cultivars of ''[[Pisum sativum]]''. Pea soup has been eaten since antiquity and is mentioned in the works of [[Aristophanes]].
